title: EXPLORATORY: generated insects in BugPicker's body-length classes
rule: a flagged design that `verify` reran with stiffer contacts (dt 0.125 ms, timeconst 0.25 ms) with no failed or flagged run counts as clean, ranked by the lower of its two robust scores. Otherwise: top 3 by robust full-run score (mean - 1 sd over 3 friction sets x 3 seeds, 30 s) among working sorters (robust >= 0.5, no failed run, meeting today's print constraints) with no penetration-flagged run; if fewer than 3 qualify, the rest are the best working flagged ones, marked flagged (see opt/LOG.md for how this rule came about)
caveat: sim ranking only; uncalibrated; openings simulated at nominal - 0.15 mm (ASSUMED undersize)
